horoscopes.horoscope: You are deeply interested in the occult and the paranormal and today, you may indulge in something to do with it. So, you may buy a full colour 15×10 glossy on shamanic rites or the tantra! Ganesha suggests using such knowledge for peaceful ends. You will explore a different side of passion in yourself. Issues that you have been arguing over with your spouse may be sorted by evening. Listen to your sweetheart first and then indulge in lovemaking. As the day may be challenging from health point of view, so you should be careful in that your health is not affected. Avoid negative thinking today. You also need to avoid anger as it could affect your emotional balance, says Ganesha. Today is likely to be a very average day on the financial front for you. Since inflow of money is not going to be satisfactory, you must avoid taking any risks, advises Ganesha. You will stay cautious throughout the day in the office. You will also win appreciation from others. You need to abide by the schedule and should not push yourself too much or you may end up falling ill. Save your energy for the next battle.

You are likely to get extra passionate and fervent today, predicts Ganesha. If your logic prevails over your heart, things will probably change for better during the course of the day. It is high time that you set into motion the poignant side of your character, suggests Ganesha. You may not like it if your partner tries to influence your thoughts and end up saying something that hurts him/her. Never forget to apologise your sweetheart if anything really goes wrong. You may not like to remain in touch with your beloved. The day will be very good for you. You will get happiness in personal life. You will get satisfaction in professional life. Your good work will get appreciated at office. This will inspire you to take up more work. You will get all round happiness. Today you are going to work at cross purposes as regards your own interests, especially in financial matters. You are quite conscious about your money, but Ganesha advises you not to flaunt it. If you are the leader of a team, you may focus on what your team members are doing today. There are chances that someone from your team tries to deceive you, so be alert. Control your temper else you may end up raising your voice.

Today, you will decide to become a bit more conscious about your health. You may or may not join a gym or measure your calories, but you will definitely sit up and take notice of your lifestyle and unhealthy food habits, predicts Ganesha. A new job is also likely, which will pen a completely new chapter in your life. You may not give importance to your love life. You may remain detached from the relationship. Don’t let disagreements reign in your mind. Ignoring your love life for work will cost you more than you think. Take the help of your sweetheart and family members if things go wrong. There will be lot many activities in office. There will be complicated issues as well there. You will remain engrossed in solving them. You may be able to fix these problems using your analytical abilities. You might have to sit for extra time in office. You will need to be very diligent in order to increase your income. If you are in job, you may need to work for extra hours to increase your financial gains. Businesspersons need to do the same. It’s a day when you might remain as busy as a bee, says Ganesha. Complex issues might irritate you. You will have some big tasks to do. If you are a team leader, then you might have to give emotional support to your team members.

You are likely start the day in the best of spirits today. Your enthusiasm and cheerfulness will be infectious, and you will be able to lift the mood wherever you go. However, your enthusiasm can be short-lived and pummelled under the weight of some bad news, leaving you distraught. Take a break in case you feel stressed out, advises Ganesha. Things are likely to look up by the time the day ends. This is an uneventful day, foresees Ganesha. You may spend the day with your sweetheart laying on the sofa discussing some interesting topics. You may start an activity and later may find it boring. A lazy yet comfortable day is on the cards. You will be physically fit today and enjoy good health. You will also find your professional life going well and may even get new projects. You will be completely positive. On the whole, it’s going to be a wonderful day for you. The day looks good for financial matters. Your past investments are likely to give you good returns today. If you have been taking interest in stock market of lately, this is going to be a good day. It will be a smooth day. You are fast, furiously efficient and almost flawless in your work. Your boss is likely to accept this fact. You may have to spend a lot of time browsing web pages in search of a crucial piece of information.

Always dependable, that is what you are. And today, you will just underline this fact in bold strokes through your fine display of commitment to work, and your dedication to your family, says Ganesha. Your company may never find a better person for the job that you are assigned to do. Even at home, your credentials as the perfect family man will shoot right off the charts. You may not find the rhythm in the relationship. Your partner may want you to be accountable for the home affairs whereas you are not likely to be happy with domestic responsibilities. Therefore, you should avoid conflicts on trivial issues that sour your relationship. The day will see, on hand renewing of old friendships. On the other hand, you will handle several issues which were long pending and were seeking your attention for quite some time. You should avoid arguing with your superiors, says Ganesha. Business plans shouldn’t be executed as planetary positions are unfavourable but at least you can work on ideas. This is the best day to work on property deals, as stars are in your favour for the same. It’s an average day for you, says Ganesha. Domestic issues may interfere with your work and you may feel the pressure, says Ganesha. At the office, you need to keep your nerve cool, suggests Ganesha. You may like to work alone or skip the tasks and simply pass the time.

Ganesha sees you keeping away from a joint venture. You are capable enough to handle big projects yourself. You are most likely to lead and coordinate large teams and extract work from them as you will. Things may not look good at the beginning of the relationship. Your sweetheart does not seem to be convinced. You may not win in the matters related to the heart. However, you will benefit if you handle the matter intellectually. You are likely to manage your emotional stability later. It’s going to be a very good day for those who are into R&D. You will present your ideas in a very impacting manner in the meetings. All this is going to give you happiness and you will be in a good mood. You will have a clear idea about loopholes that you have in your financial handling. As a result to which, your financial management will improve to greater extent. You should be able to earn good money today. A good day is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. The eagerness with which you will work today will help you finish your tasks quickly. You may learn a few trade secrets today. A hassle-free office will lead to an enjoyable evening at home.

“Every man has specific natural abilities”, said Aristotle. This seems to be true for you today. Your natural talents will be acknowledged and documented at work. This might prompt your equals to hold you up above the rest, and for your seniors to positively encourage you to scale greater heights. But as always, be careful to make sure that success does not make you heady with arrogance, cautions Ganesha. Keep yourself firmly grounded, and remember that, ‘pride cometh before the fall’. There may be a clash of minds. Pay attention to your sweetheart. You should have a good control of your mind if things don’t work your way, suggests Ganesha. Things will be pretty good when you understand the emotional matters and take precautions. You will feel happy today because you will be rewarded for your hard work, says Ganesha. This will come in as a shot in arm for you. However, you will assigned even bigger responsibilities owing to your earlier bright performance. Health issues may led to expenses. It may vary from someone’s health to your own health issues, on which you may have to spend money. Hospitalization is the worst that can reduce your bank balance. Today, you will be driven by your subconscious mind. An interesting discussion with like-minded people is also on the cards. You may have to decide on an important decision post lunch. The majority of the pending works will be completed by the end of the evening.

The crown jewel of your character will be your supreme confidence today. Try to pick up tasks that require herculean efforts, and you shall come close to achieving them, predicts Ganesha. Your nerves and buoyant nature will be infective and also leave people awestruck. Shopping with your partner is on the cards. You will select colour cosmetics and spruce yourself up for a long hour to seduce your loved one. Passion will drive you closer to your sweetheart and you seem to play a dominant role in lovemaking. You will work with lot of dedication and focus today. You will be very good at work today. However, you should keep in mind that you don’t get into a mood of settling scores with other people. You have to take care of that. Today you are going to operate exactly as per your basic nature when it comes to financial matters. Your financial decisions today will be based more on instincts, rather than any logical derivations. You are likely to grow slowly but steadily in the work front with your sheer determination and discipline. You seem to take responsibilities and pour all energies to achieve most of the tasks skillfully. You have the power to convince everyone in the team.

You are like a new hope for your company and you are assigned with many challenging projects, today. And your hard work and efforts are appreciated when you handle the projects successfully. If you are fortunate enough, you may also gain incentives very soon, predicts Ganesha. Good thing is that you will be in a romantic mood and you may expect the same commitment from your soulmate. Your honesty and sincerity will attract your sweetheart. You may take some time to build the relationship but overall a harmonious night is on the cards. Ganesha feels, that it may be a hectic day at work and may affect your hralth due to stress. Be polite as there are chances of miss-communication with your office mates. Hence it’s better to keep a low profile today. Things on the financial front look bleak, feels Ganesha, and this is all because of your extravagant nature. You shall spend money like water. If you don’t control it, you will soon be in troubled waters. You wish to complete a certain project today itself, but it doesn’t seem to happen. Some adverse circumstances may come your way. However, you should not give up. Stick to your objectives, things will be fine in a few days, assures Ganesha.

Creativity is your innate trait. But how creative can you get when dealing with day-to-day issues? You will not only answer this question with utmost modesty, but will make a great display of your creative skills by cleverly sorting out problems with your siblings, says Ganesha. You will derive pleasure by delving into knotty problems and solving them with ease. Also, you will reach out to those in need and help them in every possible manner. Your sweetheart will be in a romantic mood and the day may turn out to be a perfect one as far as romance is concerned. You are likely to bring rhythm in life and want to make sure that your relationship goes smoothly, feels Ganesha. It’s a good day for you. However, you have to use tact today. As a team leader, you will be trying to solve problems of your team. But you should be careful while conveying your decisions. Also,you might be influenced by somebody else’s ideas. You need to maintain consistency in relations – then only they will remain financially or otherwise gainful to you. This would be a good lesson to be learned today as regards finances. The stars shine brightly in your luck. It’s time to hold important meetings at the workplace. Other’s views and ideas may hold importance. You are likely to be patient and make a decision after thinking pros and cons. You will focus more on quality of work rather than efficiency.

Money is on your mind today! If you want to sort out financial matters, today is the day. You may have a good time with friends in the evening. You will also realise how much your friends value you and the respect you command in your wider social circle. Ganesha says maintaining it is important. You may plan to take some time out with your sweetheart. Family issues will also need your attention. You are not ready to pay attention to your partner’s point. Your lover may feel being ignored by you. Your partner may feel that you’re making life a bit complicated. It’s dangerous to take hasty judgments, that would be the underlying basis of your day today. You should think a lot before taking decisions, says Ganesha. It’s important to take that much care today. On the personal front, you may be too much into emotions. ‘More work means more money’ – this mantra will work in your favour as stars are showering their blessings on you today. Ganesha feels stars are indicating things are going to influence your finances positively. The day is all about how well you can manage stress. Career-related matters will be the topmost priority to you. You may also get a bit worried about your progress on the professional front. You may like to finish the pending tasks soon and want to shoulder more responsibilities.

Today, you will find yourself partitioning your time equally, and more importantly, excelling, at work as well as at home. So, while you will prove to be the right man for the job assigned to you at the office, at home you will establish yourself as the perfect family man, says Ganesha. Your emotions for your partner may be overwhelmingly high. Passion runs deep inside may be due to your partner’s look, or attire. You are not in a mood to talk but to indulge in making love till the night gets over, feels Ganesha. Jealousy is going to affect you today, says Ganesha. You will feel frustrated due to this factor. You will not be perturbed by your rival’s success but by your own failure. You need better bonding with the people around you to lessen your frustration. Accumulation of money and saving both will matter a lot to you, thus you will have strong drive for finances today. This factor will surely work in your favour and will add conviction in business or work. You are likely to be in a mood to speculate with an intention to earn fast cash. You will reap good rewards for your hard work. You may get appreciation from your colleagues and your honesty will pay off in the long run.
